name: 08.2 Repurpose and Localize from Approved Memory

parameters.query: SELECT id,payload FROM source_contents WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE

nodes.name: Apply Translation Memory and Format Contracts

parameters.query: WITH job AS (INSERT INTO localization_jobs(job_key,source_content_id,target_locale,version,brand_version,memory_version,glossary_version,status,fingerprint,payload) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'localized',$8,$9::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(job_key,version) DO UPDATE SET job_key=EXCLUDED.job_key RETURNING id), segs AS (INSERT INTO localized_segments(job_id,segment_id,source_text,target_text,memory_match,memory_version) SELECT job.id,s->>'segmentId',s->>'sourceText',s->>'text',s->>'memoryMatch',(s->>'memoryVersion')::integer FROM job,jsonb_array_elements($9::jsonb->'segments') s ON CONFLICT(job_id,segment_id) DO NOTHING), variants AS (INSERT INTO localized_variants(job_id,format,payload,fingerprint) SELECT job.id,v.key,v.value,encode(digest(v.value::text,'sha256'),'hex') FROM job,jsonb_each($9::jsonb->'variants') v ON CONFLICT(job_id,format) DO NOTHING) SELECT id FROM job
